title: Illustrative lookup work model
method: Assume 1,000 products and 200 missing-key queries. Scan counts 1,000 × 200 equality checks; map counts 1,000 inserts + 200 expected constant-time lookups. These operation types have different costs; no wall-clock speedup is claimed.
alt: Illustrative lookup work model. Repeated full scans: 200000 high-level operations; Build map and look up: 1200 high-level operations. Illustrative inputs.
